actual_Boolean_family: All two-input Boolean gates composed with all pairs of two-input Boolean children on disjoint uniform blocks, tested at all four physical coordinates; explicit physically restricted majority/AND fixture
parameter_domain: Gate and child truth-table codes 0..15; physical coordinates 0..3; constants retained as endpoint controls
arithmetic: Fraction Fourier amplitudes; exact rational prime-log vectors; signed comparisons by integer products after denominator clearing
assertions: Exact erasure B, entropy decrement D, signed residual, positive-sector residual, physical influence; M(t) bound at t=beta^2 and zero/deterministic endpoints; negative-residual witness
inequality_constants: Finite JS check uses 4 q t; analytic proof gives (2/ln2)q t. No floating-point proof.
